text:
She is tall and perfect, with radiating blue

pupils, where an Eve lazily lies in wait.

Her skin is fruit skin. Her white flesh snows

and her braids twist like thick eels.


A forest of gold grows in her white armpits.

From the trees breaks the fine new bud.

Her mouth is death's tenebrous cave.

her laughter wounds the breast of tranquil birds.


Yesterday she passed by my side, round hips,

hard tense thighs lifting the lace,

purpled lips, and I was afraid to see her,


for she is in such a way already predestined

that, one understands, on seeing her, she walks, abandoned,

toward the first man who must possess her.

translation.title: One
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the disturbing predestination of the erotic portrait.
